product_metadata.title: Ice Cube Trays Silicone Set of 2, Sphere Ice Ball Maker with Lid and Large Square Ice Cube Molds for Whiskey, Reusable and BPA Free-Purple
features: NON-STICK & EASY RELEASE - Made of durable silicone, our ice cube trays can be easily twisted or pushed from the bottom to remove ice cubes and balls for an easy release.Ideal gifts for Halloween.
ICE BALL MAKER - Upgraded 6 spherical ice balls (1.8in) are perfect to cool your craft cocktails, iced cold brew coffee, popsicles, infused mint for Mojitos, or frozen lemonade.
ICE CUBE MOLD - 6 large square ice cubes (2 in) melt slowly, ideal for chilling your Old Fashioned, Scotch Whiskey, Bourbon or Blended Whiskey.
BPA FREE & DISHWASHABLE - Adopted 100% food grade silicone to ensure absolute food security. Nontoxic and odorless, BPA-free, please rest assured to use our ice trays.

DIY FAVORITE FLAVOR – Temperature resistance within - 104℉ to 446℉, you can make cocktails, cordials, liqueur, whiskeys, ice tea, iced coffee drinks, juices and great for making popsicles, freezing sauces, baby food etc.
